Commands used to manipulate a vehicle's (or ammo box) inventory. Not to be confused with [[:Category:Command Group: Vehicle Loadouts|Command Group: Vehicle Loadouts]]. For commands related to a unit's inventory see [[:Category:Command Group: Unit Inventory|Command Group: Unit Inventory]].

Also contains commands related to service vehicles e.g., [[getFuelCargo]].
